scientific_interpretation: No tested same-data operator representation beats the baseline. The orthogonal DCT is exactly equivalent. Enlarging the source class or splitting old/recent quadratic regularization opens more weak directions and worsens recovery. The current cached Kerr ray-to-pixel map is therefore not identified as the practical bottleneck on these samples; the inverse prior/regularization is the next target.
scope: No visibility-domain or delay-resolved acquisition was run.
O2 and O3 change source representation/regularization, not the underlying Kerr photon map.
The result does not prove the current physical operator is globally optimal.
q8/q12 agreement is not a continuum error certificate.
